name: TIP41C
description: Workhorse NPN power transistor in TO-220, complementary to the TIP42C. Used for audio output, motor and solenoid drive, and linear pass elements up to 6A. Lead order is B-C-E with the tab as collector.

TO-220.notes: TO-220, label toward you, leads down: B-C-E. The metal tab is the collector (electrically live).

typical_application: Audio power output stages, DC motor and solenoid drivers, linear regulator pass transistor. Always heatsink; isolate the tab from grounded sinks with a mica/silpad washer.
gotchas: lead order is B-C-E; the tab is the collector and is electrically live
low hFE (15-75) means it needs substantial base current; often driven by a smaller transistor (Darlington or BD139)
the suffix letter sets the voltage grade: TIP41C is the 100V part
isolate the tab when bolting multiple devices to a shared heatsink
